title: S-92 Quick Reference
intro: For training use only. This is an informal quick reference of selected S-92 RFM limitations. Always use the official RFM as primary reference.

groups.title: Propulsion & Drive Limits — Dual Engine (Q% / TGT °C / Ng % / Np %)

items.label: Notes
lines: 86% Q above 100 KIAS is a flight-control-load limit, not a gearbox limit.
One engine may exceed 100% up to 110% provided the other is proportionally less and the sum ≤ 200%.
Np overspeed trip: 120%. Ng overspeed trip: 108.5%.

groups.title: Propulsion & Drive Limits — Single Engine / OEI (Q% / TGT °C / Ng % / Np %)

items.label: Avoid prolonged operation
lines: 36% to 49% — tail rotor drive shaft critical range
56% to 67% — engine power turbine critical range

items.label: General
lines: VNE power off: 120 KIAS (or lower VNE power-on value if below 120 KIAS)
Max with landing gear down/in transit: 165 KIAS

items.label: Degraded configurations (all): 120 KIAS max
lines: One primary flight control servo inoperative

items.label: Ground / low-speed
lines: Max groundspeed takeoff/landing: 65 kt (50 kt per later manual change)
Max sideward flight / crosswind hover: 35 kt
Max rearward flight / tailwind hover: 35 kt

items.label: Other
lines: Max for landing gear emergency blowdown: 90 KIAS
Max for opening/closing sliding door or window: 80 KIAS
Max standard wiper operation: 40 kt; improved wiper: 100 KIAS

items.label: General
lines: Cat A ground level helipad: 5,500 ft density altitude or 6,000 ft pressure altitude, whichever is lower
Icing flight (RIPS on): up to 10,000 ft pressure altitude

items.label: Coupled operations
lines: At or below 120 KIAS: min 50 ft AGL (monitor controls below 200 ft; VMC required below 100 ft)

items.label: Weight
lines: Max takeoff and landing weight: 26,500 lb (12,020 kg)

items.label: Loading
lines: Max cabin floor loading: 75 lb/ft² (366 kg/m²); heavy-duty floor: 200 lb/ft² (976 kg/m²)
Max combined baggage/ramp load: 1,000 lb (454 kg); max shelf load: 300 lb (136 kg)
Fuel imbalance above 700 lb (317 kg) combined with unbalanced cargo may exceed lateral CG limits

items.label: Ambient temperature
lines: Engines shut down below -25 °C ground OAT for over 1 hr: warm to 0 °C for 8 hr, or use Cold Weather Pre-heat kit before flight
Pitot heat / engine anti-ice ON below +5 °C OAT

items.label: Crosswind & slope
lines: Cat A horizontal takeoff/landing: max 35 kt crosswind
Cat A ground level helipad: max 22 kt crosswind
Slope landing: 10° nose up/down slope, 13° left/right side up-slope

items.label: Prohibited
lines: 360° hovering turns in less than 12 seconds
Flight in freezing drizzle/rain or supercooled large drops (SLD)
Use of OEI power ratings except for an actual engine failure

items.label: Other
lines: Max bank angle, one primary flight control servo inoperative: 30°
Low fuel light(s) illuminated: avoid pitch >10° nose up or >5° nose down
Fuel crossfeed: Cat A emergency operation only; Cat B cruise flight only

items.label: Back-to-back starting
lines: OAT above +15 °C: 2 starts, 5 min cooling, 2 starts, 30 min cooling, then repeat
OAT +15 °C or less: 4 starts, 15 min cooling, 4 starts, 30 min cooling, then repeat

items.label: Fuel temperature (Jet A / A-1 / JP-5 / JP-8)
